narration: Late in the morning on January 21st, the house is quiet.

nodes.speaker: Michael Fields
nodes.text: Everybody, it's good to see everybody. I've got reason to feel good about where we're headed, and I want to tell you why. I'm more hopeful about this country than I've been in a long time. Pay went up faster than prices this year. That's real money in people's pockets. The economy grew this year. Now the question is whether you feel it. Not everybody's feeling it, though. More people are out of work than a year ago. Hope isn't being satisfied. It's believing next year can be better than this one, and working for it. If you want a job, you ought to be able to get one. Until that's true, that's my first job.

nodes.speaker: Michael Fields
nodes.text: I'm from New Mexico, and I've seen what neighbors can do when they've got a reason to hope. That oath is a promise to the future, and honestly, I'm looking forward to the future.

nodes.speaker: Michael Fields
nodes.text: I believe in the shop on the corner and the family saving to open it. I think their best years are ahead. This country's bigger than any election, and there's room in it for all of us. Come along.

nodes.speaker: Michael Fields
nodes.text: To Congress: we're in this together whether we like it or not. I'll be knocking on your door.

nodes.speaker: Michael Fields
nodes.text: And I'll tell you where I won't budge. The federal answer on legal cannabis sales is no. Put a bill on legal cannabis sales on my desk and it comes back vetoed.

nodes.speaker: Michael Fields
nodes.text: I trust Vice President James Johnson. You'll see why.

nodes.speaker: Michael Fields
nodes.text: Governors, state lawmakers: I need you, and I'll act like it. My door's open.

nodes.speaker: Michael Fields
nodes.text: If you've been up at night this year doing the math on your bills, I hear you. That's who I'm working for. Thank you. God bless you, and God bless America.

narration: Late in the morning on March 4th, you head out for the evening. You step up to the podium. The country is listening.

nodes.speaker: Michael Fields
nodes.text: Madam Speaker, members of Congress, folks at home, it's good to see everybody. I've got reason to feel good about where we're headed, and I want to tell you why. I'm more hopeful about this country than I've been in a long time. Pay went up faster than prices this year. That's real money in people's pockets. The economy grew this year. Now the question is whether you feel it. Not everybody's feeling it, though. More people are out of work than a year ago. None of that happened by accident. Millions of people kept showing up, to work and to each other. If you want a job, you ought to be able to get one. Until that's true, that's my first job.

nodes.speaker: Michael Fields
nodes.text: I'm glad to tell you the country is in better shape than it's been in a while.

nodes.speaker: Michael Fields
nodes.text: I believe free people, given room, build things nobody could've planned, and I can't wait to see what they build.

nodes.speaker: Michael Fields
nodes.text: And I'll tell you where I won't budge. Take legal cannabis sales. Right now the federal answer is no. Put a bill on legal cannabis sales on my desk and it comes back vetoed.

nodes.speaker: Michael Fields
nodes.text: If you've been up at night this year doing the math on your bills, I hear you. That's who I'm working for. Thank you. God bless you, and God bless America.
